newsitem.title: USA: Compaq Q2 seen surpassing Street consensus.
newsitem.headline: Compaq Q2 seen surpassing Street consensus.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp, which is expected to report its second quarter earnings early Thursday, is expected to handily beat Wall Street consensus estimates of $1.39 a share, analysts said.

According to First Call, the consensus estimate for Compaq is $1.39 a share, with a range of $1.33 to $1.47. Analysts and traders said that a "whisper" number of $1.50 and slightly higher is being bandied about on Wall Street.
"The game now is how much are they going to beat consensus?" said Louis Mazzucchelli, a Gerard Klauer & Mattison analyst.
"I've talked to people who said they are giving off strong vibrations," Mazzucchelli added.
Compaq shares have risen sharply in the past three days in anticipation of its better-than-expected earnings. Wednesday, its shares were up 2-5/8 to 122 in very active trading.
"It better be at least $1.50," said one trader, adding that he expects many investors will sell on the news. The trader pointed out that Compaq is up about $24 in nine days.
Compaq is also expected to unveil a major new manufacturing strategy, as part of a new corporate PC launch, aimed at lowering its manufacturing costs and PC prices.
